features.name: kiro prompts install only for skills in the global kiro dir
features.description: Host audit 2026-10-23: 11 of 15 ~/.kiro/prompts files pointed at ~/.kiro/skills/<group>/SKILL.md for groups feat-090 moved into per-repo packs, so /audit, /jira, /intake and others read a missing file. install.sh now copies a prompt only when every SKILL.md it names exists after store-packs, and removes a stale copy of one that does not.
acceptance_criteria: a prompt whose SKILL.md is missing is not installed, and an old copy is removed
a prompt whose SKILL.md exists, or that names none, is installed
on this host every ~/.kiro/prompts file points at an existing SKILL.md after install.sh
features.evidence: Tests first: the missing-skill and skipped-output cases failed on the old install_kiro_prompts; 9 checks pass after, also under /bin/bash 3.2. install.sh now calls it after store-packs. On this host install.sh printed 4 files installed and the 11 pack prompts skipped; every ~/.kiro/prompts file now names an existing SKILL.md, and the 4 kept files match the repo source byte for byte. Two subagent reviews (correctness, security): no confirmed defects; both noted that writing through $(...) rewrote trailing newlines, reverted to the direct sed redirect (no new logic, no re-review). harness-verify all gates passed.
